summary: Iteration 3 testing for inline People-Also-Ask feature. Both backend (6/6 pytest) and frontend flows pass. PAA is now strictly inline (Home, AI Mode, ProjectDetail) and the obsolete /people-also-ask tab + route are removed. Tabs nav verified as: All, AI Mode, Work, Images, Videos, Research, Shopping, Contact, More. PAA payload is contextual to query (graph-theory queries return graph-related FAQs; 'burnout' easter-egg also returns burnout-themed PAA; broad 'anita george' falls back to default 4-item diverse set). /api/ai/stats returns faq_entries=20. Hallucination guard still works for unknown topics.
critical_code_review_comments: App.js has no catch-all <Route path='*'> — visiting /people-also-ask renders the Layout shell (header+tabs+footer) with an empty <main>. This is acceptable (no crash, no PAA tab) but consider adding a 404/NotFound route for nicer UX on any unknown path.

knowledge_base.people_also_ask uses Jaccard-style token overlap divided by len(q_tokens). This naturally favors short queries (e.g. 'graph theory' tokens={graph, theory} matches well), but very long queries dilute the score. The default-fallback safety net (threshold 0.05) covers this well.
PeopleAlsoAskInline opens item index 0 by default (useState(0)). On AI Mode the first PAA matches the user's query — feels intentional. Confirmed working.

success_rate.backend: 100% (6/6 pytest in iteration_3 + previous 10/10 still valid)
success_rate.frontend: 100% (Home paa-preview/paa-inline w/ 4 items + toggle; AI Mode deep-link + fresh search both render ai-paa-block; ProjectDetail paa-on-detail renders w/ 4 items; related-search chips link to /ai-mode?q=; /more has no PAA link; /people-also-ask returns 200 with no crash and no PAA tab; nav has 9 expected tabs and no PAA tab; 0 console errors)
